arc_fake_player 3.2.0 validation (2026-10-25 Asia/Shanghai)

Python regression suite: 1107 checks passed across 12 files
(16 new in test_social.py: FavorStore persistence/clamp/cooldown/grudge/
settle/describe + CombatReflex state machine full paths).
Command: python -X utf8 tests/run_all.py -q

JavaScript interaction regression suite: 20 tests passed.
Digging simulation: 7 primary scenarios passed in default and strict mode.

Python compileall and JavaScript syntax check: passed.
Config schema v3 -> v4 migration verified on the live server config.

In-game verification on MCBETestServer (BDS 1.26.45, Endstone 0.11.10,
arc_ai_helper 2.4.0, no real players online):
- Crowd scheduler end-to-end with a dummy LLM endpoint: Aqing/TieDan/MuTou
  came online with randomized play times (80/87/38 min) + assistant TianXing
  => 4/4 players online.
- Card goals and stealth behavior active; /ai list shows per-bot favor line.
- ActorDamageEvent smoke: attacker-less damage command and sim-vs-sim
  bot:attack both correctly ignored (no favor change, no crash).
- Console quirk found (not a plugin bug): raw console `ai set <url> ...`
  fails to parse ":" in URLs ("Syntax error: Unexpected ':'"); set config
  in config.json + /ai reload instead. In-game command bar unaffected.

Not covered in-game: real-player attack -> reflex retaliation chain and
vengeance loop (requires a real online player); covered by unit tests.
Test LLM credentials cleared afterwards; auto_online left enabled.

Environment: Python 3.13.9; Node.js v24.16.0; Windows.

Wheel: endstone_arc_fake_player-3.2.0-py3-none-any.whl
